camel_example: aliyun iot BatchUnbindProjectDevices --region cn-hangzhou --Devices.1.DeviceName Ee2000000 --Devices.1.ProductKey a1BwAGV0000 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --ProjectId a12000000
description_en: Dissociates devices from a project in a batch
description_zh: 调用该接口批量解除项目中关联的设备
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-unbind-project-devices --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --project-id a12000000 --devices ProductKey=a1BwAGV0000 DeviceName=Ee2000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchUnbindProjectDevices

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

<props="china">您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。</props>

<props="china">
> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html。</props>
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Studio console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb). In the upper-left corner, select the corresponding instance. In the left-side navigation pane, click Project Management.
2. In the list of common projects, find the target project, click the project card, and then view the project ID in the address bar
parameters.help_zh:
项目ID。
1. 您可登录[物联网应用开发控制台](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.1e7830fagdybMb)，在页面左上角选择对应实例后，在左侧导航栏单击项目管理。
2. 在普通项目列表中，找到目标项目，单击项目卡片，在地址栏中查看
parameters.name: project_id
